intro_questions: What is the primary function of a rocket engine?
Define a non-breathing engine in one sentence.

topics: Working principle of solid rocket engines
development.content:
Definition of non-breathing engine
Working principle of solid rocket engines
Components of solid propellant grain
Ignition and combustion process
Thrust generation mechanism

Advantages of solid rocket engines

Comparison with liquid engines
Storage and handling characteristics
Reliability and simplicity factors

Real-world applications of SRMs
Limitations in thrust control
Safety protocols for solid propellants
Environmental considerations
Future trends in solid propulsion

summary_questions: Explain why solid rocket engines are considered non-breathing.
Identify one major advantage and one major disadvantage of solid rocket engines.
Describe the working principle of a solid rocket engine using the grain structure.
